text.en:
No. S 77 THE WORKMEN'S COMPENSATION

ENACTMENT, 1957 Declaration of Approved Hospitals under Section 15( 1) In the exercise of the powers conferred upon me by Section 15 ( 1) of the Workmen's Compensa-Enactment tion Enactment 195 7 I hereby declare that the No.5 of 1957. ' ' under-mentioned hospitals are approved hospitals for the purposes of the Enactment :- .The General Ifospital, Bandar Seri Begawan. The Suri Seri Begawan Hospital, Kuala Belait. The Panaga Hospital, Brunei Shell Petroleum Company Ltd., Seria. Gazette Notification No. S 85 of 1957 is hereby cancelled. Dated this 7th day of June, 1975. P.D.N. LAILA DI-RAJA PENGIRAN ABDUL MoMIN M entri BesarJ Brunei. Ref: SUK/613/56.
